headline: 艾許莉・羅伯茲談重聚
context: 美國歌手艾許莉・羅伯茲（Ashley Roberts）1981年生於亞利桑那州鳳凰城，18歲隻身赴美闖蕩演藝圈，後來加入女子團體 Pussycat Dolls。她接受《衛報》訪問，回憶自己不理會舞蹈老師勸阻、堅持追夢的過程，也談到與團員金柏莉・懷特（Kimberly Wyatt）、妮可・史蔻辛格（Nicole Scherzinger）重聚的心情。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Roberts on refusing to take no from her dance teacher, moving to the US aged 18, and reuniting with Kimberly Wyatt and Nicole Scherzinger Born in Phoenix, Arizona, in 1981, Ashley Roberts joined the Pussycat Dolls in 2002. Their debut single, Don’t Cha, spent three weeks at No 1 in the UK in 2005. The sextet sold more than 55m records worldwide before splitting in 2010. Roberts has since appeared on I’m a Celebrity … Get Me Out of Here! and Strictly Come Dancing, and was a judge on Dancing on Ice. She hosts a show on Heart 00s every Saturday. The Pussycat Dolls – now a trio of Nicole Scherzinger, Roberts and Kimberly Wyatt – are currently on a 21-date tour. This tutu picture was taken at my first ever dance recital , and I’m happy as can be. It was the 80s, so everything’s pink and fluffy, and I have big hair and a serious fringe. I love the way my feet and hands are angled a little bit abnormally. I thought I was posing for the gods. Continue reading...
sources.title: Pussycat Dolls singer Ashley Roberts looks back: ‘It was my dream come true, but we were all burned out’

voice_text: 有一段訪談，美國歌手艾許莉・羅伯茲，回憶自己當年不理會舞蹈老師的反對，18歲就隻身跑去美國闖演藝圈，後來加入了女子團體 Pussycat Dolls。她也談到，跟團員金柏莉・懷特、妮可・史蔻辛格重聚的心情。
